chunks: And from his sermon (peace be upon him) regarding the pillars of religion.
The pillars of religion are four: the truthfulness of faith, the practice of the law, good character, and the distribution of intellect.
ai.seo_question: What are the four pillars of Islam according to Imam Ali in Nahj al-Balagha?
ai.summary: Imam Ali (peace be upon him) delineates the four pillars of Islam as truthfulness of faith, observance of religious law, good character, and intellect, offering a holistic framework that integrates creed, ritual, ethics, and reason. This classification reflects the Shia emphasis on the unity of knowledge and action, where intellect serves as the foundation for recognizing truth and guiding moral conduct. The statement underscores that true Islam requires not only external compliance but also internal conviction and intellectual clarity.
